gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-elms-sans: Wide-spaced letters strung out like beads on a long thread make Bruno Ace SC feel unmistakably its own, with no thinning anywhere. Elms Sans carries long reading in a pressure-free, ballpoint-like line.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-encode-sans: Encode Sans keeps its c from slumping into an o, while Bruno Ace SC joins strokes at full thickness. Paragraphs stay legible and low-key under the louder heading.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-encode-sans-expan: Encode Sans Expanded pulls the tips of its c well apart, softening Bruno Ace SC's rounds, whose rims match the stems. Encode Sans Expanded stays approachable at body size.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-encode-sans-sc: A ruler-drawn, constant-width line runs through Bruno Ace SC, its letters spaced out like beads on a thread. Encode Sans SC adds a shallow curl at the terminals and wide gaps, giving the heading a low-key partner.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-encode-sans-semi-: Spaced-out and uniform, Bruno Ace SC keeps the same line width in curves and straights. Encode Sans Semi Condensed, with its open-mouthed s, moves along smoothly across paragraphs.

Encode Sans Semi Expanded keeps its rounded letters open and easygoing, a gentle follow-up to Bruno Ace SC. And because Bruno Ace SC is true monoline, the two share a clean, drawn-line look on the page.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-exo: Exo keeps wide gaps that stay crisp at tiny sizes, while Bruno Ace SC draws a single-width stroke in every glyph. Display swagger from one, quiet legibility from the other.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-exo-2: Clean curves full of daylight mark Exo 2, while the wire-bent s in Bruno Ace SC never thins at the spine. Exo 2 can be set a touch smaller without losing openness.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-faculty-glyphic: Faculty Glyphic leaves clear openings in its rounded letters. Across a full paragraph this sans-serif keeps each line easy to follow, while the w in Bruno Ace SC has no thick or thin strokes.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-fahkwang: Bruno Ace SC traces every stroke at the width of one stylus, its letters strung like beads on a thread. Bruno Ace SC makes the statement; Fahkwang handles the sentences.
